LabVIEW files the VI reader's tests read (tests/test_vi_reader.py), unchanged copies of public, openly licensed
files. Each folder holds its project's licence (LICENSE), whose notice goes with the files.

                    MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2023 Alexander Ranschaert

                    BSD 3-clause licence, Copyright (c) 2018, JKI
